styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF studio sweep, light-grey #F4F4F6 alternation for macro shots, ink-black #1A1A1A section bands for trust/CTA screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, front-left soft key with fill, controlled metallic highlights, soft contact shadow, no dramatic cast shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio sweep, no visible tabletop texture
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short bold headlines wrapped in 「」, no serif, no handwriting
styleLock.iconSystem: flat solid circular badges and thin-line callout icons, one simple glyph each
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; consistent scale across spec and variant lineups; product always grounded with a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium metal travel-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white background #FFFFFF, ink-black band and text #1A1A1A, brushed silver-grey metallic tone #C7CBCF, and one signal-red accent #D0342C; neutral-cool studio mood; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; flat solid circular badges and thin-line callout icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with clean breathing margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 11 张 800x1200 切片拼合分析自箱包详情页长图；主产品经识图确认为铝镁合金硬框拉杆箱，与源文件名『旅行拉杆箱1』一致。已剥离：品牌 logo 与品牌名、品牌系列文案、客服承诺具体数字（8天/16小时）、二维码与店铺徽章、源图实拍文案（改为 selling_point/callout 文案槽，投放时填入）。角度展示屏（灰/黑/蓝）与首屏主图角色重复，已合并为 shot-01/02 与 VARIANT。与库内 suite-xiangbao-lvxinglaganxiang（大容量多尺寸软硬壳通用款、叶绿点缀）以金属硬壳材质、包角/TSA 三锁扣/双轮微距卖点及信号红配色区分。尺寸与重量数据来自源图，属源产品事实，模版中以 callout 文案槽替代，不硬编码。
